title: Quick dependencies scrub and handoff
content:
Purpose: ad-hoc, timeboxed spreadsheet to scrub outstanding cross-team dependencies before the July release window. Use this as a lightweight handoff doc for on-call and delivery leads.

Columns: Item | Owner | Priority | Status | Blocker | ETA | Slack thread | Related ticket | Quick note

1) Model config rollout: v2 quant profile | Marco Ruiz | P0 | in_progress | waiting on QA test vector set (see tkt) | 2025-07-02 | #infra-models | RE-4127 | infra needs final kernel bump; PR #789 contains test harness.

2) Private deploy package sign-off | Priya Nair | P1 | blocked | security scan flagged missing KMS rotation test | 2025-07-08 | #sec-integrations | RE-4189 | Sec requested HSM config example; blocking Dedicated customers in EU.

3) Batched inference perf baseline | Evan Carter | P1 | in_review | flaky ci perf runs on p3dn | 2025-07-03 | #serving-runtime | GH-PR-802 | Running a manual perf run today 06/30. If passes, remove canary label.

4) Console rollout: per-route cost graph | Samantha Lee | P2 | todo | UI copy not finalized | 2025-07-10 | #product-console | PROJ-245 | Need final microcopy from PM; design low-prio bug sprawl.

5) Customer A: private pilot onboarding | Aisha Patel | P0 | at_risk | missing network ACLs from customer infra team | 2025-07-05 | #cs-customer-a | CS-598 | CS and infra sync scheduled 06/30; propose temporary VPN workaround.

6) Observability retention expansion | Marco Ruiz | P3 | todo | budget approval pending | 2025-07-20 | #observability | FIN-332 | If finance approves, schedule infra changes in next sprint.

7) API throttling rules for embeddings | Priya Nair | P2 | in_progress | unresolved edge cases for batched clients | 2025-07-06 | #api-platform | RE-4201 | Draft policy in PR; needs load-test signoff.

8) Docs: quickstart private deployment | Samantha Lee | P2 | in_review | remaining screenshots outdated | 2025-07-07 | #docs | DOC-112 | Asking engineering for updated console screenshots today.

Quick status summary (for PM sync):
- P0 items: 2 (model config rollout, customer A pilot) — both needing infra/security unblockers.
- P1 items: 2 — perf baseline flakiness and private deploy scan.
- P2+: several items dependent on copy/design/finance.

Notes to self:
- If model perf run fails again, escalate to infra lead (Marco) and consider temporary kernel rollback.
- For customer A onboarding, collect list of exact ACL rules customer infra requires and create a one-page checklist to hand to their network team.
- Keep PRs small: attach failing perf logs to PRs to reduce back-and-forth.

Unresolved questions to raise at 06/30 sync:
- Who owns final KMS/HSM documentation for Private installs? (sec vs infra)
- Can we accept a temporary VPN-based onboarding for early pilots? (legal/ops risk?)
- If perf CI remains flaky, what is fallback cadence for model rollout (can we extend canary to 2w)?

Action items (owner -> action):
- Marco -> run manual perf suite and post logs to GH-PR-802 by EOD 2025-06-30.
- Priya -> escalate KMS test requirement to Security and propose an acceptance criteria doc by 2025-07-01.
- Evan -> document exact CI flakes (time, env) and link to RE-4201.
- Aisha -> assemble ACL checklist and share in #cs-customer-a thread; prep temporary VPN proposal.
- Samantha -> update screenshots and mark DOC-112 ready for final review.

Freeform/brainstorm snippets (informal):
- "If we tighten batching for embeddings we might avoid the throttling edge-case, but need to measure 95p latency impact."
- "Consider a small 'pilot' KMS integration with test keys to unblock pilots while security finalizes HSM docs."

Version history (lightweight):
- 2025-06-24: created (initial scrub, first pass items)
- 2025-06-27: added customer A pilot + security blocker
- 2025-06-30: refreshed ETAs, added perf run action, changed status for perf -> in_review

Use: copy this sheet into the release channel for morning standups; keep it lightweight — aim to clear P0s within 48 hours of detection.
